title: D. Harold Byrd's Vought built flying saucers for Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: Well, it turns out VA Aerospace built all the flying saucers for Wright Patterson in the 40s and 50s under a guy named Alfred C. Loading.

plain: An aerospace company, Vought, which the story links to a man named D. Harold Byrd, is said to have built "all the flying saucers" for Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, in the 1940s and 1950s. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this without naming a source, and says the work was run by a man he calls Alfred C. Loading. If true, it would mean the military had disc-shaped aircraft built by a private contractor.
